name: lib_finset_exists_cut_sum_ge_quarter
statement: (V : Type) [DecidableEq V] (f : V → V → ℕ) (hsym : ∀ u v, f u v = f v u) (hirr : ∀ u, f u u = 0) (S : Finset V) : ∃ s : Finset V, s ⊆ S ∧ (∑ u ∈ S, ∑ v ∈ S, f u v) ≤ 4 * ∑ u ∈ s, ∑ v ∈ S \ s, f u v
closed: ∀ (V : Type) [DecidableEq V] (f : V → V → ℕ) (hsym : ∀ u v, f u v = f v u) (hirr : ∀ u, f u u = 0) (S : Finset V), ∃ s : Finset V, s ⊆ S ∧ (∑ u ∈ S, ∑ v ∈ S, f u v) ≤ 4 * ∑ u ∈ s, ∑ v ∈ S \ s, f u v
informal: Weighted max-cut bound: for a symmetric, zero-diagonal weight f on a finset S there is a cut (s, S \ s) carrying at least half of the total weight (ordered-pair sum over S×S ≤ 4 × the one-directional cut sum). Promoted from Mathlib2.comb_exists_cut_half_edges_aux1.
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : DecidableEq V] (f : V → V → ℕ), (∀ (u v : V), f u v = f v u) → (∀ (u : V), f u u = 0) → ∀ (S : Finset V), ∃ s ⊆ S, ∑ u ∈ S, ∑ v ∈ S, f u v ≤ 4 * ∑ u ∈ s, ∑ v ∈ S \ s, f u v
known_as: comb_exists_cut_half_edges_aux1 V f hsym hirr S
